QuestInfo.name: Willpower Flower
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart is looking for you. What tedious work does he have for you this time?
QuestInfo.1: A symbol of willpower? You didn't know a flower could hold such meaning. You might as well go get it to cheer up Cygnus.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriu to go to El Nath's Dead Mine.)#k
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Flower of Fate to Cygnus.

0.0: The final season is already upon us. This time I want to make a private request.\r\n#L0##bHm, I don't know about this. If you want me to pluck a dragon's nose hair or get, like, 500 scales from a big sea monster...#l\n#k
0.1: ...We'll come back to those later. For now, I'm only interested in the Flower of Fate.\r\n#L0##bFlower of Fate? That's a fairytale.#l\n#k
0.2: That's right. It's always in the romantic ones. Legend says that the knight gives it to show loyalty to his lady. But did you know that flower actually exists?\r\n#L0##bWhat? How do you know that?#l\n#k
0.3: Anyone with 5 volumes of Plant Encyclopedia under their belt would know. It just so happens to grow in El Nath.\r\n#L0##bHey, you're the only one in the world who reads that kind of book!#l\n#k
0.4: That's right. I read them so uncultured types like yourself don't have to. You simply have to get the #bFlower of Fate#k. It might be a tad difficult, but I believe in you.

yes.0: What Cygnus needs is #e'strong will'#n... If you can get this flower, it will empower her motivation.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to head to El Nath's Dead Mine.)#k

no.0: The Flower of Fate actually exists. It's not just about my request...don't you think it's worth it to go for the sake of exploring?

npc.0: What Cygnus needs is 'strong will'... If you can get this flower, it will empower her motivation.\r\n#b(Talk to Kiriru to head to El Nath's Dead Mine.)#k

item.0: Sigh... I feel like I'm getting weaker by the day.\r\n#b(Bring her the Flower of Fate from El Nath's Dead Mine.)#k
